description: This file contains multiple classes implementing onboarding flow screens for an Android app, including welcome, goals, duration, analytics, and finish screens, using GuidedStepSupportFragment.

classes.name: WelcomeOnboardingFragment
classes.description: Welcome screen with options to proceed or skip onboarding.

classes.name: GoalsOnboardingFragment
classes.description: Screen for selecting multiple goals via checkboxes.

classes.name: DurationOnboardingFragment
classes.description: Screen for selecting preferred workout duration via radio options.

classes.name: AnalyticsOnboardingFragment
classes.description: Screen for opting into analytics collection.

classes.name: FinishOnboardingFragment
classes.description: Final screen indicating onboarding completion and starting app.

methods.name: onCreateGuidance
methods.description: Creates guidance info for each onboarding screen.

methods.name: onCreateActions
methods.description: Creates actions (buttons, checkboxes, radio options) for each screen.

methods.name: actionToGoalId
methods.description: Maps action title back to goal ID.
